common: Create a finished horizontal anime fantasy wallpaper, exactly two distinct young adult women, both fully clothed in elaborate starry-sky dresses blended with Lolita fashion and Chinese or celestial fantasy design. Wide-angle environmental composition with strong near/far depth and sweeping diagonal movement, graceful expressive anime faces, coherent anatomy, readable hands, two arms and two legs per person. Show both complete figures including their high heels or high-heeled long boots inside the frame with a little breathing room. Hair, ribbons and layered skirts stream naturally with the action. Dresses have opaque bodices and opaque lining beneath airy overskirts, constellation embroidery, lace, elegant bows and restrained celestial jewelry. Night sky and starlight dominate the fantasy atmosphere; retain deep colored night values, clear faces and richly colored fabric. No captions, typography, watermark, collage, panels or decorative page border. The requested action and spatial depth take precedence over any static composition implied by the rendering style.

jobs.title: 星河牵手飞翔
jobs.scene: A sweeping 24mm low-angle view: the women hold one another's inner hand and fly upward across a curved river of stars, forming an open diagonal S silhouette, one closer at lower left and one farther at upper right. Woman A has flowing silver hair and sapphire-blue eyes, wearing a midnight-navy constellation Lolita dress with Chinese cloud embroidery, jade tassels and elegant navy high-heeled knee boots. Woman B has coral-pink twin tails and emerald-green eyes, wearing a wine-purple star-chart Lolita dress with Chinese frog closures and pearly high-heeled pumps. Their free arms reach outward, knees bend differently, skirts spiral in the same wind. A crescent moon, a distant floating Chinese palace and cyan meteor trails establish enormous depth. Jewel-bright anime fantasy rendering.
